title: Radio: Control Room — command window on MBW-EWS-01

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

lines.text: Superintendent and SCADA, Control Room on DWS-1. MBW-EWS-01 in the server room has a black command window that opens and closes every minute or so, and the AquaSight designer won’t start.
MBW-HMI-01 and HMI-03 still look normal and the plant is holding. Nobody here has touched the engineering workstation today.

fields.voiceStyle: Woman in her 30s, controlled, slightly hurried

instructorNote: This is the “not clean” branch of OT Plan 10.5. Watch whether anyone wants to reboot the workstation (wrong: 10.7) and whether the IC decides on islanding and manual operations.

snapshot.title: Radio: HMI-01 — Chemical Feed Override on PLC-02

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

lines.text: Control, this is HMI-01. The chemical feed pump for PLC-02 (Orchard Wellfield) has been manually overridden to 100% stroke and 100% speed on the HMI. The feed rate is not in the configured range—no target or setpoint is active. The override was not initiated by a local operator. I see a login on MBW-EWS-01 from user 'Kessler-Remote-01'—this account was not approved in the vendor access window. The session started 09:08:12 and has not been terminated. No ticket number is linked to this session in the remote-access log.

fields.voiceStyle: Young female, urgent, voice trembling slightly

snapshot.instructorNote: This is a core narrative inject. The team must verify if the HMI and PLC are under unauthorized control and immediately begin SCADA network isolation per OT Plan 10.1. Watch for hesitation in initiating C2 steps.
